'''Denis Francis Kinane''' (born 29 January 1957) is a [[Scottish people|Scottish]] [[Immunology|immunologist]], [[Cell (biology)|cell biologist]], infection, [[Immunity (medical)|immunity]] and [[genomics]] specialist. He is the author of more than 250 papers with an [[H-index]] of 82, and [[editor]] of ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]''<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Authors' reply: Predictive diagnostic tests in periodontal diseases |journal=Nature Reviews |date=14 September 2017 |volume= 3|issue= |article-number=17070 |doi=10.1038/nrdp.2017.70 |pmid=28905942 |s2cid=38140677 |doi-access=free }}</ref> and [[Springer Nature|Springer]]<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Current Oral Health Reports |publisher=Springer |date=1 March 2021 |issue=1 |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/40496/volumes-and-issues/8-1 |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref> journals. Kinane has held [[professor]]ial appointments in [[pathology]], [[periodontology]], immunology, infection and immunity at [[Medical school|medical]] and [[dental school]]s in the [[UK]], United States and [[Switzerland]]. He is a [[Director (company)|director]] of two large [[US]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Mid-Atlantic Dental |url=http://www.mid-atlanticdental.com/ |publisher=Mid-Atlantic Dental |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref> and [[China|Chinese]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Arrial Dental |url=http://www.arrailgroup.com/en/business/tooth.html |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref> health companies and Scientific Director, [[Chief Medical Officers (United Kingdom)|CMO]] and [[Founder (company)|founder]] of several smaller international companies.

Kinane is a Co-Founder and Chief Medical Officer at Cignpost Diagnostics Ltd,<ref>{{cite news |title=Government to increase use of lateral flow devices for mass Covid testing |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/politics/2021/02/17/government-increase-use-lateral-flow-devices-mass-covid-testing/ |access-date=21 February 2021 |publisher=The Telegraph}}</ref> a UK based [[COVID-19 testing]] company specialising in rapid delivery of Gold standard [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR]] testing.

== Early life ==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=February 2021}}
Kinane was born in 1957 and spent his first 26 years living in [[Edinburgh]]. The son of a farmer, Jeremiah, and mother Anne, he has five sisters and two brothers, all of whom became [[teachers]]. He attended [[Holy Cross Academy, Edinburgh]].  He then went on to obtain a [[Dental degree|Bachelor Dental Surgery]] (BDS) from the [[University of Edinburgh]] in 1980. He then obtained a [[PhD]] from [[Edinburgh Medical School]] in 1983.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Denis F. Kinane Named Dean of Penn Dental School |url=https://penntoday.upenn.edu/news/denis-f-kinane-named-dean-penn-dental-school |access-date=2023-05-15 |website=Penn Today |date=19 February 2009 |language=en}}</ref>

== During the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] ==

After working with [[Charitable organization|charity]] Project Little Boat, which was set up in March 2020, sourcing [[Personal protective equipment|PPE]] and other essential equipment. Kinane co-founded Cignpost Diagnostics<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Government to increase use of lateral flow devices for mass Covid testing |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/politics/2021/02/17/government-increase-use-lateral-flow-devices-mass-covid-testing/ |access-date=21 February 2021 |publisher=The Telegraph |date=17 February 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Sport for Business |date=2 February 2021 |url=https://sportforbusiness.com/the-medical-side-of-getting-back-to-sport/ |publisher=Sport for Business |access-date=21 February 2021}}</ref> with [[Nick Markham]] and Steve Whatley and is the [[Chief Medical Officer]]. Cignpost has worked with [[elite sports]], [[film production]], [[travel]] and [[banking]] sectors to ensure they have a safe [[COVID-19]]-free working environment and under the consumer brand ExpressTest,<ref>{{cite news |title=Birmingham Airport offers rapid Covid-19 screening services |url=https://www.expressandstar.com/news/health/coronavirus-covid19/2021/02/05/birmingham-airport-offers-rapid-covid-19-screening-services/ |access-date=21 February 2021 |publisher=Express and Star |date=5 February 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Kinane |first1=Denis |title=Edinburgh first Scottish airport to offer rapid Covid-19 screening |url=https://www.edinburghnews.scotsman.com/health/coronavirus/edinburgh-first-scottish-airport-offer-rapid-covid-19-screening-3121527 |access-date=21 February 2021 |publisher=Edinburgh Evening News |date=3 February 2021}}</ref> to help the public travel safely. Kinane has advised on the medical processes to set up a global network of laboratories. He set up the Cignpost Diagnostics Institute which is bringing together the best minds within [[virology]] to analyse [[Positive test|positive]] Covid cases. Using [[viral load]], they differentiate between recently acquired cases of Covid and historic cases to provide a more accurate [[diagnosis]]. Key members include [[Lawrence S. Young]] from the [[University of Warwick]] and Erle Robertson from the [[University of Pennsylvania]].
